purpose: Establish an OCCT-independent material-set oracle, measure a machining-native directional material field, execute a maintained external fallback comparator, and revisit RCS-011 valid-but-wrong and timeout evidence without weakening physical truth.

sources.title: Manifold v3.5.3 release
sources.fact_used: Pinned maintained external mesh/level-set fallback candidate and source commit.

sources.title: Manifold LevelSet API
sources.fact_used: LevelSet exposes edgeLength and tolerance construction controls; Decompose/Volume expose comparison metrics.

sources.title: Multi-dexel based material removal simulation and cutting force prediction with GPGPUs
sources.fact_used: Multi-dexel workpiece representation uses three independent orthogonal dexel sets and is directly motivated by machining material-removal workloads.

sources.title: Tri-Dexel Based Cutter-Workpiece Engagement Determination For Robotic Machining Simulator
sources.fact_used: Tri-dexel workpiece models remain an active machining-simulation technique with scalable resolution and swept-volume engagement.

sources.title: RCS-011 measured summary
sources.fact_used: Near-coincident retrace produced a valid materially wrong freehand batch; dense sampled-pose B-rep fallback timed out 10/10.

sources.title: RCS-012 measured summary
sources.fact_used: A coarse 0.5 mm volumetric representation erased a real 0.001 mm plunge/cusp, so representation resolution is an explicit semantic error channel.

hypotheses.statement: A conservative OCCT-independent material field can bound the final material set of fixed-axis manual/freehand cutter paths strongly enough to identify RCS-011's valid-but-wrong retrace result.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The independent oracle interval includes both the RCS-011 exact-reference material result and the effectively unchanged-stock freehand-batch result, or fails closed-form validation.

hypotheses.statement: A directional z/tri-dexel material field can represent self-crossing, retrace, overlap, stationary engagement, cut-through and sub-tolerance Z removal without replaying one B-rep Boolean per canonical segment.
hypotheses.falsified_by: It erases positive-volume sub-tolerance removal, loses required disconnected bodies, is nondeterministic, or its declared interval fails to contain the independent oracle on its claimed domain.

hypotheses.statement: Resolution must remain an explicit representation error channel rather than a manufacturing tolerance; refinement should monotonically tighten material bounds on qualified fixture classes.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Refinement widens the declared material interval, changes semantic classification without an uncertainty explanation, or requires silently snapping a physical feature to zero.

hypotheses.statement: Manifold 3.5.3 can serve as an executable external robustness comparator for local fallback/reconciliation work, but mesh success alone is insufficient for STEP-authoritative qualification.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The pinned package cannot execute on the supported CI platform, or its measured material/topology behavior supplies no useful independent comparator evidence.

hypotheses.statement: A bounded founding fallback can be narrower than all fixed-axis manual motion: unsupported error budgets or reconciliation classes must refine, remain accepted_pending, or refuse rather than invent exactness.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The recommendation relies on watertightness/validity alone, lacks explicit material/spatial bounds, or silently accepts a case outside its measured domain.

policies.step_reconciliation: mandatory-before-STEP; no mesh/dexel state is STEP-authoritative until conventional B-rep reconstruction passes RCS-005
policies.sub_tolerance_policy: positive physical removal is never snapped to zero; a representation unable to resolve it must preserve an analytic witness or refuse authoritative use
policies.provenance_policy: operation/body/boundary lineage is programme-owned; ray/cell/triangle IDs are diagnostic only

cases.qualification_note: Measured, but accepted only if the candidate's conservative material interval closes inside policy.

rcs011_controls.required_result: independent oracle must separate the materially correct sequential result from the valid-but-wrong near-full-stock batch
bounded execution must record success/error/timeout and compare any successful material result to the same oracle family; prior 10/10 timeout evidence remains preserved
